description: Create a real Shopify cart through the existing Paragon catalog adapter, only after an explicit customer request for exact variants and quantities. Returns a customer-reviewed checkout URL, NOT an order or a payment. No card, email or address accepted. Do not automatically retry a timeout or uncertain result, which could create duplicate carts. Never claim inventory is reserved or payment is authorized.

customer_requested_cart.description: Only true after the customer explicitly asked to prepare these exact variants and quantities. Not payment authorization.

name: paragon_create_cart
